science: The modern energy is close to NASA and lower in binding than JANAF by 1.058 kJ/mol. The energy-aligned JANAF/NASA ratio falls from 0.939 to 0.818 over 1500-4000 K, so the growing difference is mostly thermal at high temperature. This needs explicit manifold and anharmonicity accounting rather than interpreting a newer energy anchor as a complete thermal correction.
modern: The 2025 TIPS paper uses ground-vibrational rotational sums plus harmonic vibrational factors and a switch to a fully analytic product approximation at higher temperatures for the principal isotopologues. It is not a full coupled rovibronic high-temperature spectrum. The exact principal 16O14N16O nodes after spin-product removal give Q/NASA 0.96865 at 1500 K and 0.86081 at 4000 K. The disagreement is scientifically useful but does not by itself select one full thermal model. The supplied 2025 corrigendum was checked: its symmetry correction concerns the mixed 16O14N18O isotope, not the principal table used here.
importance: NO2 participates in atmospheric NOx chemistry and radiative/photochemical cycles. Those oxidizing and illuminated environments are outside the present reducing equilibrium grid.

Natural-mass translation is only an elemental proxy for principal-isotope internal states.
